newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka rupee ends shade low on import covering.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka rupee ends shade low on import covering.

text.p: The Sri Lanka rupee closed slightly lower against the dollar on Tuesday, despite substantial import covering due to the market being well supplied with the greenbacks, dealers said.
The rupee closed at 58.52 against the dollar, after opening at 58.49.
"Despite substantial import covering the dollar-rupee exchange rate moved only about five cents, as the market is very well supplied withd dollars," said an American Express Bank dealer.
Dealers say the market is well supplied with dollars, due to the heavy inflow of foreign funds to the Colombo stock market.
Overnight call money closed at 9.25 percent, with the market well offered, dealers said.
